title: fix(mcp): don't call paid-only models unknown for Quest Pollen keys
author: lotxo1

gist.summary: MCP model validation now checks the public registry when a model name or alias is absent from the API key’s model list. Paid-only video, 3D, and embedding models are passed to Gen, so a Quest-Pollen-only key receives the actual paid-Pollen requirement instead of an “unknown model” error. Names absent from both registries remain unknown, with suggestions; listModels still shows only models available to the key.

image.prompt: In a cozy garden workbench scene, Polli wears tiny librarian glasses and points a CRT monitor robot toward a public model catalog beside a smaller key-specific list, with code-plants growing around them. Polli, the main character, is a cute pixel art bee mascot with a yellow body and dark brown horizontal stripes, small black legs, two black antennae, black vertical oval eyes, bright pink rectangular blush marks on cheeks, a small happy smile, and small rounded light blue translucent wings; she is small-to-medium sized, never oversized, and strictly pixel art, never realistic. Cozy pixel art, 8-bit aesthetic, soft pastel gradients, warm lighting, retro gaming vibes; prominent lime green (#ecf874) glow, warm cream background, and dark purple (#110518) outlines.
